note: Characters in shipped example sentences that no catalog word explains. Each one is a gap in the vocabulary, not in the analyser: the JLPT lists the catalog is built from do not contain these words, so the tokenizer has nothing to find. Listed here so the every-example-parses test stays meaningful instead of being deleted, and capped so the list cannot grow quietly. Fixing one means adding the word to the source lists and regenerating vocab.json - see doc/en-us/features/content-catalog.md.

allowed.word: 鞄 (かばん) - the catalog has the kana form only
速い (はやい) - the catalog has 早い only
東京 (とうきょう) - a proper noun the JLPT lists omit
